title: Verify the generating-function recurrence for Meixner sequence A214615

source.citation: Tong Niu, A short proof of Mathar's 2013 recurrence conjecture for the Meixner sequence A214615, arXiv:2605.03170

translation.notes: The paper’s Meixner recurrence generates an exact prefix. Encoding its exponential generating polynomial in `Q[t]` makes the differential identity `(1+t^2)F′-(1-t)F=0` a coefficientwise Noether check.
